CONTENT

 Video Preview: https://youtube.com/shorts/Fz5oRj2VteY?si=yLUwXVCAPXjNcd4M

16x16 base Dungeon Tileset crafted for old-school RPG enthusiasts. 

All of the sprites are made in 16x16 canvas.

  • 2-Edge Wang Tiled Walls for Procedural Generated Maps
  • Ground Tiles Variation
  • Animated Water Tiles
  • Animated Torches
  • Dungeon Traps(Boulder, Ground Spikes, Mechanical Blades,Wall Flamethrowers, Pits, Bear Traps...)
  • Interactables(Pressure Plate, Wooden Crates, Portals, Keys...) 

This asset pack contains the following files:

  • Tiled-Maps
    • a collection of json and tmj files containing free Tiled maps samples.
